dataset: Dataset for ADL Recognition with Wrist-worn Accelerometer (HMP)
authors: Bruno B, Mastrogiovanni F, Sgorbissa A
acquisition: single tri-axial wrist accelerometer @ 32 Hz (0-63 coded, -1.5..+1.5 g); 14 ADL; multiple subjects/trials
note: Self-care activities (brushing teeth, combing hair, eating meat/soup, drinking from a glass) with walking/stairs as contrast.
